title: Correct direct Circle-SBI relationship and model Coinbase/Circle stablecoin economics separately from XRP demand
decisions: Record Circle SBI Japan K.K. as a direct 50/50 Circle-SBI JV established in 2025 for USDC distribution in Japan. Circle consolidates it as a VIE despite 50% equity; Q2 2026 filing reports no significant operating results through June 30.
Record SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank as Circle strategic equity investors with USD25M each at the 2025 IPO; keep this distinct from the Circle-SBI Japan JV and SBI's historical Ripple stake.
Correct the prior 2026-10-30T083100Z snapshot's no-direct-Circle-SBI statement; preserve the old snapshot and append a correction.
Record Coinbase's Q3 2026 SEC disclosure that its Circle arrangement was renewed on the same terms and average USDC in products reached an all-time high.
Record Circle's Q2 2026 SEC-reported USD655.3M H1/USD324.6M Q2 distribution costs to Coinbase and the balance-linked/ecosystem-growth formula.

Model stablecoin revenue as a function of average USDC balances, reserve rates, distribution terms and incentives. Q3 balance growth was partly offset by lower rates; do not treat revenue as direct XRP flow.
Keep Circle's 84% Circle Reserve Fund exposure, BlackRock management and bank cash separately modeled; SBI/BlackRock JPYSC tokenized-MMF MOU is a shared manager link, not a common reserve pool.
Treat native USDC and RLUSD on XRPL as stablecoin liquidity; do not infer native XRP demand or bridge use without transaction-path analysis.
Keep Coinbase as multi-issuer distributor: USDC with Circle, RLUSD with Ripple, and Open Standard/OUSD founding-partner role. Token-level balances and revenue splits remain unknown.
Do not admit Coinbase/Circle financial metrics as XRP prediction features until causal mapping and walk-forward validation demonstrate incremental out-of-sample value.
rationale: Primary SBI and SEC documents establish a direct Circle-SBI JV and equity relationship missed in the prior addendum.
Coinbase Q3 and Circle Q2 SEC filings quantify stablecoin distribution economics and rate sensitivity.
Circle USDC and Ripple RLUSD coexist on XRPL, but no direct Circle-Ripple partnership or automatic XRP demand follows.
next_action: Obtain Circle Q3 2026 results on November 4; reconcile USDC circulation, reserve yield, Coinbase platform share, Circle SBI Japan operating results and XRP/XRPL transaction paths. Continue Binance PoR wallet crosswalk and public-only bitbank MCP evaluation.
